function: Time-varying mmWave massive MIMO channel estimation: denoises coarse LS estimates of consecutive slots into the current channel matrix (pp. 3, 6).
system: Point-to-point mmWave massive MIMO-OFDM, 64 transmit and 64 receive antennas, 28 GHz, 5 paths, 120 km/h, no RIS (pp. 3, 8).
method: Homogeneous Denoising GAN: CNN U-Net generator in spatial and angular domains, patch discriminator; supervised adversarial plus L2 loss, unsupervised variant with noisy labels (pp. 5-6, 13).
data_channel: SV time-varying simulator (Model I), random-walk-mobility and Gauss-Markov simulators (default 3000 train, 1000 test), DeepMIMO O1 28 GHz (Model IV: 75% train, 25% test) (pp. 3, 8-9).
test_conditions: Same-condition training and testing over SNR -5 to 15 dB; shifted tests: train 0 dB, test 5 dB; train 5 paths, test 3 paths (pp. 10, 13).
baselines: Non-learned: LS, LMMSE. Learned: DnCNN. Also ablation variants HDnCNN, DnGAN-CNN, HDnGAN-CNN, HDnGAN-L (pp. 10-11).
metrics: NMSE; downlink spectral efficiency with MRT precoding (pp. 9, 11).
complexity: Order of complexity O((Lg+Ld)NR NT), proportional to antennas and network depth; no FLOPs or runtime (p. 5).
openness: none; uses the public DeepMIMO dataset (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 9: "we utilize the DeepMIMO dataset [50]" for Model IV, whose measurements "are served for training" (75%) and online testing (25%). Models I to III are custom simulators (pp. 3, 9).
q2_support: p. 13: "an environment with 5 paths (1 for LoS, 4 for NLoS), while" and "the test data is obtained from an environment with 3 paths"; direct test without retraining. The 0 dB to 5 dB shift alone would not count.
q3_support: p. 10: "baselines such as LS, LMMSE and DnCNN"; "Fig. 4 illustrates the NMSE performance of LS, LMMSE," DnCNN and HDnGAN. DnCNN is the existing CNN denoising estimator (pp. 2, 4); SE is compared in Fig. 5 (p. 11).
q4_support: p. 5: "the computation complexity of our model is" O((Lg + Ld)NR NT), proportional to the number of antennas and the layer depth.
q5_support: p. 9: "we utilize the DeepMIMO dataset [50]", a public channel dataset, for training and testing Model IV. No code or data link of its own is given.
notes: Area 2: the learned GAN denoiser estimates the channel (pp. 3, 6). No RIS; RIS appears only in the bibliography. q1 and q5 rest on Model IV only (DeepMIMO O1, Table II, p. 9); Doppler coefficients are added to the DeepMIMO channels (p. 9), and Models I to III are custom simulators. q2 counts the 5-to-3-path test (p. 13); Table III varies rho without stating that training and test differ (p. 10), so it is not counted. q3 is borderline if the reviewer treats DnCNN as an ablation, since it shares the generator structure (p. 10), but it is the earlier CNN estimator of the literature (pp. 2, 4). q4 is an order of complexity only; no FLOPs, parameter count or runtime is reported.
